## Keywords

{{< glossary slide-layout placeholder theme designer colour-contrast slide-show >}}

## 17.1 Slides and layouts

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- A layout is the plan of a slide.
- Its placeholders are dashed boxes where we click and type.
- The first slide uses Title Slide, and most slides use Title and Content.
- **Lab task:** Make a title slide and a content slide. Which key starts the show?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/layouts.png)
:::
::::

## Live demo · Slide Builder

{{< sim file="sims/slide-builder.html" poster="sims/slide-builder.png" title="Slide Builder: one good slide" task="**Show:** paste seven long sentences, then keep four short points, choose a theme and add the photo with alt text. **Ask:** which message appears when a point is too long?" >}}

## Try it 1 · Layouts

a) What is the dashed box "Click to add title" called?
b) Which layout fits the first slide of a talk?
c) Which layout puts a list next to a picture?

::: {.answer}
a) a placeholder
b) Title Slide
c) Two Content
:::

## 17.2 Themes and Designer

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- A theme gives all slides the same colours and fonts.
- Designer suggests designs for the slide we are on.
- Dark text on light, or light text on dark, gives strong contrast.
- **Lab task:** Choose a theme and two Variants. Can you read it from two metres?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/themes.png)
:::
::::

## Example · A theme for the hours

Huda's two slides are black on white.
**How does Huda give the talk one look?**

::: {.reveal}
1. Huda opens the **Design** tab and clicks an orange theme.
2. **Both slides** change at once: the same colours and the same font.
3. On slide 2, Huda opens **Designer** and picks one of its designs.
:::

## Try it 2 · Themes

a) On which tab do we choose a theme?
b) What changes when we click a theme?
c) Why is light grey text on light blue a problem?

::: {.answer}
a) Design
b) the colours and fonts of all slides
c) Nobody at the back can read it.
:::

## 17.3 Pictures and alt text

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- Insert › Pictures adds a picture to the slide.
- A corner handle keeps the shape, and a side handle stretches it.
- Alt text says in one sentence what the picture shows.
- **Lab task:** Add a picture and its alt text. Which handle do you drag?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/pictures.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 3 · Pictures

a) How do we resize a picture and keep its shape?
b) Who needs the alt text of a picture?
c) Where do we write the alt text?

::: {.answer}
a) We drag a corner handle.
b) a person who uses a screen reader
c) Right-click › View Alt Text
:::

## 17.4 Few words on each slide

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- Each slide has one idea and 3 to 5 short points.
- Each point has about eight words or fewer.
- The speaker says the details, and the notes pane keeps them.
- **Lab task:** Shorten your points. Which details did you move?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/text-amount.png)
:::
::::

## Example · Seven sentences

Huda's first slide has seven long sentences in small letters.
**How does Huda make it clear?**

::: {.reveal}
1. Huda keeps **four short points**: the hours, Friday closed, Saturday, from 1 December.
2. "Tell every customer" is something to **say**, not something on the slide.
3. The font stays **big**, about 24 pt or more.
:::

## Game challenge · Slide Doctor

{{< sim file="sims/slide-doctor.html" poster="sims/slide-doctor.png" title="Slide Doctor: fix the slide" kind="game" task="**The story:** Huda's colleagues send slides for the Monday meeting, and each one has a problem. **Play:** choose the best fix for each slide." >}}

## Try it 4 · Fix the slide (harder)

a) What is the best fix for a slide with seven long sentences?
b) What went wrong with a shop photo that looks tall and thin?
c) Which layout fits the last slide with "Thank you!"?

::: {.answer}
a) Keep a few short points and say the rest.
b) It was stretched with a side handle.
c) Title Slide
:::

## Summary

- We choose a layout and type in its placeholders.
- One theme gives the whole talk one look with strong contrast.
- We resize pictures from a corner and give them alt text.
- Each slide has one idea and a few short points.
